project_summary: Predictive maintenance for CNC machines using sensor data

components.name: Sensor data pipeline
components.description: Collection of vibration, temperature and spindle load readings over MQTT, buffering at the edge and storage in a time-series database.

components.name: Anomaly detection model
components.description: Unsupervised anomaly detection on sensor time series, failure probability per machine and retraining with labelled maintenance events.

components.name: Maintenance dashboard
components.description: Plant-level dashboard with machine health scores, anomaly timeline and maintenance work order creation.
